altText: Taylor Swift photo: Taylor Swift Eras Tour
body: she's singing at the CMAs TONIGHT and my hands are literally shaking 😭 my brain went straight to 2013, when she slowed "Red" down with Alison Krauss on that stage. 8pm ET on ABC and i will be screaming at my tv https://www.longlivets.com/?era=the-life-of-a-showgirl&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=news
why: Nov 18 CMA pre-show beat, X half written first as its own post: the nerves first, then the one anchoring fact (first CMA performance since 2013's acoustic "Red"). Sourced: GMA (2026-11-13) and Showbiz Junkies report Taylor performing at the 60th CMA Awards, Wed Nov 18, 8pm ET on ABC and Disney+ from Bridgestone Arena; last CMA performance 2013 ("Red" with Alison Krauss, Vince Gill et al.); nominated Single of the Year for "I Knew It, I Knew You". Intake #6840 was the lead only. No CMA moment in the Vault yet (#6891), so the era link. Pre-show only: no setlist, no performance described.

critique.rationale: Leads with the fan nerves two hours before she performs, then one checkable fact: her first CMA performance since the 2013 acoustic "Red" with Alison Krauss. Time-bound to tonight and links to the Showgirl era.

rewrite.changes:
I fixed the claim the judge flagged and kept the link exactly as it was.

- **Wrong fact removed:** I cut "first time on that stage since 2013," because she performed "Lover" at the 2019 CMAs. I didn't add a different claim in its place.
- **2013 detail kept as a memory:** The caption now says "my brain went straight to 2013," followed by the slowed-down "Red" with Alison Krauss. The checkable detail stays, but it's no longer presented as a "since then" fact.
- **Voice and formula unchanged:** The lowercase gush, the "8pm ET on ABC" detail and the single emoji are all still there. I added no new facts and no new stock phrases.
- **Link not touched:** The judge called the raw UTM-tagged link clunky on X, but the rules don't let me change or drop links, so it stays exactly as given. X counts any link as 23 characters, so the caption is well under the 280 limit. If clunkiness still costs points, the fix is a shorter link on your side, not an edit to the caption.
